content: Menase Yoom Efraim Yoom Yaa Amun Kerundoon
Amaan arimbed, Yosef yaa daanoon “Eb ambe kuu korereyiib kii.” andoone wengamberekore, ye karub dana ayoob Menase yoom Efraim yoom kuu yambe Yekowiib yaa benwonoon.
Kwane, Yekob yaa eb dana Yosef kuu monoon kii andiiwe wengamberekore, angkeen yirimbed mangdomon aromnene yaro diboroon.
Kwanekore, Yekobbed Yosef yaa yedmoon “Aromkono Korem ye Godbed kambong Lus
yaa Keenan ambibkin aom kuyaambed ne yaa amun keruwe

yedmewoon ‘Nembed eb yaa dana yemoon bangkabdaniine yewudmo kere wananeen, angkon nembed eb kuu ongmaniine ambibkin yemoon yi ambokab keraneeb angkon nembed Keenan ambibkin okad korem kuu eb yaa kabdaniine eb awoyambed okad kee aron korem korem yeman kandaniib.’ andoon.

Godbed kwamune andoon kowe, eb karub dana ayoob Idyip aombed wanabeebkob, ne kuu yomanbed manaan kuu kimingke nekareb ne dana keraniin. Efraim yoom Menase yoom kuu Ruben yoom Simion yoom kwanaan areb kwamune neka keraniin.
Dana yena ari wanabaneeb kuu ebmanmo kere eb dana ayoob kee kuye ambibkin aom okad yumbon kandaniib kuu yi ambanga yaningko yaambed.

Eb ena Reksel bobneen kowe, yu dowad kwanaan kui. Ne kuu Aram ambibkin ye okad dabonmo yaambed ika meniine, Reksel kuu Keenan ambibkin wedyambed kambong Efrat dia bobnuune, ne mimyob darewoob kowekori, nembed Efrat
kiwaan kebed yaa yu kuu mangkaan.” andoon. (Yekob yaningko mamaa kuu Israel.)
Kwane Israel kuu Yosef ye karub dana wedmendekore, yembed kaamonoon “Kee kane awene?” andoone
Yosefbed neman yedmoon “Yi kuu ne dana, Godbed ne yaa kiri kee bangkawoon kei.” andoon. Kwane Israelbed yedmoon “Ne yaa benmenebko nembed yi yaa amun kerunda.” andoon.
Israel ye indob kuu wud dabunoon amborom kuu kiomnoon kowe, ye kuu korobe wedmindeban. Kowe, Yosefbed ye dana kuu be ye dia monoone yambembed mandamuk keendekore kangkudereboon.
Israelbed Yosef yaa yedmoon “Ne kuu angkon ika eb murubia kamune wedmainban ande meenaan, kumban Godbed yimin yedmoon kowe, eb dana kwangkon wedmaan kii!” andoon.
Andoone, Yosefbed yambe ye yon dangbo ari dibiib kuu benangkanekore, bumangke ye murubia kuu okad yiri kankubunekore,

Efraim kuu Yosef ye dingki wiwi angkambed awinenekore, nenwene Israel ye dingki an angka kowoon. Angkon, Menase kuu Yosef ye dingki an angkambed awinenekore, nenwene Israel ye dingki wiwi angka kowoon.

Kumban Israelbed ye dingki wiwi kuu an angka yirene ningki Efraim ye korok ari kowekore, ye dingki an kuu wiwi angka yirene ayi Menase ye korok ari kowoon. Menase kuu ayi kumban, ye awo ye dingki anbed ye korok ari kowoon. Efraim kuu ningki kumban, ye awo ye dingki wiwimbed ye korok ari kowoon.
Kwane, Yosef yaa amun kerune yedmoon

content.text: “Ne God kuu nawo Abraham yoom nambe Aisek yoombed wengambiriwen yi God.
Ye kuu ne yaa kuu sibi oonidan areb oonewembirimameen ari mene kibikee ye God.
Ye kuu Engyu areb arud ye barang korem yaambed ne yaa awawimaan ye God.
Godbed awandoko nawo Abrahamiib nambe Aisekiib neyiib nub aningko areb aningko darewoob kerime.
Kwane yi awoya yemoon kerok.” andoon.

content: Andoone, Yosef kuu wedmoone yambe ye dingki wiwi kuu Efraim ye korok ari kowoone wedmekore ye dowakenban keroon kowe, yembed awodki ye dingki wiwi Efraim ye korok ari kowoon kuu kanangkanene Menase ye korok ari kowande
yedmoon “Ambe, yii! Keke ayi kii. Kowe, eb dingki wiwi kuu kande ye korok ari kowe.” andoon

kumban, yambembed yiminban andekore yedmoon “Ne dana ee, nekaad. Ye kwangkon yaningko darewoob kerene awoya yemoon keraneen kumban, ye damanbed ye ayi yaa burudande yaningko miin darewoob keraneen. Ye awoya kuu ambibkin maa maa nimingke nimingke keraniib.” andoon.
Andekore, kuyaron arimbed yi yaa amun kerunde yedmoon

content.text: “Eb aningko yaambed Israel nembed amun kerundi,
Godbed eb yaa Efraim areb Menase areb kerubdok.” andekore,

content: Efraim yaningkodin Menase yaningko yoman yedme kowoon.
Kwanekore, Israelbed Yosef yaa yedmoon “Ne kuu bobnandamiin kumban, God kuu eb yaa dore awabdimamaneen kowe, yembed eb kuu eb ambeya yi okad kari ika nenwananeen.
Eb kuu eb aagoroka yi korok kowe, Amorodan yaambed ne kerewangiib ne anangkawiib kumbed Sekem okad kandaan kuu kabda.” andoon.
